display_long_description:
The vortex is open, and the fighter is you. Are you ready to claim your place among the stars?
Key Features:
•	High-Octane Star Defense: Experience an intense, fast-paced arcade wave shooter where you stand your ground against a relentless cosmic assault.
•	Immersive Cosmic Environments: Battle on the edge of a futuristic space platform surrounded by massive fleet ships, distant orbital stations, and burning celestial bodies.
•	Dynamic Saber Mechanics: Dual-wield high-tech energy blades with seamless motion tracking. Deflect oncoming hazards and slice through waves of projectiles in any direction with satisfying precision.
•	Built for Meta Quest: Developed using native OpenXR and Meta SDK protocols, optimized to deliver smooth performance, crisp visuals, and immersive haptic feedback on your controllers.
How to Play:
1.	Track the Threat: Keep your eyes on the horizon as glowing energy projectiles rush toward your platform.
2.	Slice & Score: Swing your sabers to destroy targets, maintain your streak, and push your high score to the limit.
3.	Defend Your Station: Watch your health bar closely—too many missed targets will compromise your shields and end your run!
 
Recommended Store Details:
•	Game Modes: Single-Player, Arcade/Endless Wave Defense
•	Supported Controllers: Touch Controllers
•	Supported Player Modes: Standing, Roomscale (Comfortable stationary gameplay)
•	Comfort Rating: Comfortable (The action comes directly to the player, minimizing artificial motion sickness)
